WHY HELPER_MISSING (the stop path): the upstream class Gemini (Gemini/gemini.py:8) defines no stop, abort, cancel or halt method; its complete surface is execute, setdebug, flush, getvar, getstatus, getversion, setvar, start_pipetting, close and open (Gemini/gemini.py:8-126), and close() is a pass (Gemini/gemini.py:88-89). Its only motion start is START_PIPETTING (Gemini/gemini.py:84-86), which starts the program Gemini has loaded. The only stop-like command text in the Gemini files is BMX/BMY/BMZ in the log parser (parselog/parselog.py:74-76), and fwparse shows those are the low-level LiHa commands Gemini sends to its C5/C6 subdevice, not host-pipe commands (parselog/parselog.py:235-259, 136). Sending them through the host pipe would invent a route the clone does not show. The error table's 'Cancel was pressed' is a reported code, not a command (Gemini/gemini.py:19). An R2 liquid handler that starts pipetting therefore cannot meet SAFE-045 without inventing a stop, and the driver declares no @estop and no safe-state action. The package is a complete direct-Driver attempt with a fake and a native port; it is not a passing package.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the python-object family and PythonObjectDriver. A direct Driver over Gemini is used instead because the x-cap start action, the configurable variable read/write and the missing-stop safety question are not a plain method map. The fake implements only the Gemini surface (G7 reads the Python 2 source leniently and warns LEGACY_SOURCE).

COVERAGE (fake backend only): reads status (GET_STATUS), version (GET_VERSION) and the configured variable (GET_VARIABLE); one write of that variable (SET_VARIABLE, formatted with the upstream %.2f) with an operator_required range; one action, x-cap.btownshend.start_pipetting.v1 (START_PIPETTING), listed in catalogue_requests. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording; every status/version/variable value in it is marked # placeholder. The hardware factory is a separate Python 3 pywin32 port of the same pipe client (native.py) and was never imported or run. NOT COVERED: any stop or quiescence confirmation, the loaded Gemini program's state, the plunger, the configured variable's meaning and range (operator data), the pipe protocol against a real Gemini, and any MHS-Device-level evidence.

No hardware was attached, no hardware backend was started, and the upstream clone was never imported, installed or run (it is Python 2 and Windows-only). The package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run retriage-drivers-2-001) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null. No human reviewed or tested it; no hardware run is claimed. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review confirms HELPER_MISSING: the pinned Gemini pipe client starts pipetting but provides no stop/abort/cancel and close() is a pass; the log parser's LiHa stop strings are not a demonstrated host-pipe route. test_driver.py restores the stock no-failed-gates assertion, fake.py now preserves the no-op close lifecycle, and driver.py, facts.md and site-limits.example.json remove the unsupported dimensionless unit and narrow citation claims. reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json were regenerated. Three functional fake cases pass; the gate and strict collector remain failing at G3/SAFE-045 and NO_ESTOP, and the stock gate test remains failing while blocked.
